name: Msafe Equipments Ltd
title: Msafe Equipments Ltd - 544695 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Msafe's FY26 revenue rose about 45% to Rs 103.5 crore with 39.5% EBITDA margin, but management guides to lower-margin steel and formwork mix and rising debt, and its rental yields and utilisation claims are unaudited on the call.

utilisation.quote: my factory is working throughout the day, sometimes 24 hours, and we are fully jam-packed

capex.peers_comment: Management said there is no entry barrier; a peer (Technocraft) is reportedly entering domestic rental and building a formwork plant, per an analyst question.
capex.quote: Including the investment in rental assets and the new plant, total capex will be approximately 130 crores this year.

triggers.label: FY27 capex ~Rs 130 crore, debt to rise
triggers.quote: total capex will be approximately 130 crores this year

triggers.label: No entry barrier in rentals
triggers.quote: There is no entry barrier. However, we consider yields of 32% to 38% to be on the lower side.

triggers.label: Inventory ~Rs 24 crore, ~80 days
triggers.quote: Inventory days have increased to around 80 days and inventory reached about 24 crores.

triggers.label: FY27 ~50% CAGR, revenue Rs 150cr+
triggers.quote: We will definitely achieve a 50% CAGR

guidance.quote: we expect a growth momentum with a CAGR of approximately 50%
In the first year, we have set a modest target of 30-40 crores.
In our core business, we are expecting about 20% growth.
The 40% margin might fluctuate slightly, but overall, we will be growing.

guidance.value: partial start by December 2026, full by May 2027
guidance.quote: We will partially start by December 2026, and it should be completely finished by May 2027.

red_flags.label: Inventory build and days up to ~80
red_flags.quote: Inventory days have increased to around 80 days and inventory reached about 24 crores.

red_flags.label: Management declined PAT and margin guidance
red_flags.quote: We don't want to commit to a specific PAT figure yet

red_flags.label: Aluminium inventory gains not on books
red_flags.quote: that benefit has been quite large and is not yet fully reflected on the books

evasions.quote: I would need to consult with my compliance team whether I am allowed to disclose those exact figures.
Revenue is continuously increasing, so we are not in a position to give you a firm figure right now.
